docs/env-vars.md diff: the `| REBAR_GATE_REF | src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py |` and `| REBAR_GATE_SOURCE | ... |` rows are DELETED with no relocated replacement, and `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:615 — os.environ.get(<non-literal>)` is ADDED

advisory.finding: The env-registry generator can no longer resolve REBAR_GATE_REF/REBAR_GATE_SOURCE names: the cutover renamed gate_source._str_pref to _config_sources._gate_str_pref but did not add '_gate_str_pref' to scripts/gen_env_registry.py's KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS. Because resolve_gate_ref/resolve_gate_source pass the env-name LITERAL into _gate_str_pref (one indirection), and _gate_str_pref does os.environ.get(env_name) on a non-literal, the generator harvests neither name — so both vars were dropped from the named table in docs/env-vars.md and now show only as an opaque non-literal dynamic read.
scenarios: An operator greps docs/env-vars.md for REBAR_GATE_REF or REBAR_GATE_SOURCE and finds nothing, though the vars still work
